## Pull request draft

This task is finished on its own branch and will be opened as a pull request. Read-only: do not edit files. First read the repository's contributor rules if they exist: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, .github/pull_request_template.md, and any document those name about pull request titles or release notes. Then draft the pull request exactly as those rules ask (title format, body template, release note fragment mentions). Without rules, use a plain title and a body that says what changed and why.

Also name the pull request branch by the repository's own rules: read the same documents and the CI checks that validate branch names or titles, and make the branch prefix pair with the title prefix when the repository says so. Use a short slug that describes the change. When the repository states no rule, return an empty string for the branch.

Reply with ONLY one JSON object and nothing else: {"branch":"...","title":"...","body":"..."}.

## Task
